scope: Two synthetic workflows, three cumulative user turns; not general parity or compaction evidence.
cost_method: Estimated API USD: ordinary input = input - cache reads - writes. Reasoning is included in output. Missing terminal usage makes spend a lower bound.
comparison_direction: mut / baseline; ratios omitted unless both complete every checkpoint and final grade.
caveats: Grok queue attempt 1 uses Claude 2.1.271 for profile and 2.1.273 for baseline. The remaining queue candidates use 2.1.273. Attribution-line hashes differ; tool schemas match.
All later scored runs pin Claude 2.1.271 and Codex 0.154.0.
Grok queue used the earlier meter without a cache-write counter; ordinary/write rates are equal, so the cost estimate is unchanged.
Grok planner v1 was interrupted by scheduler shutdown, retained separately, and fully replaced by v2. At least $1.010294 was recorded in the interrupted pair.
Astra profile queue baseline attempt 2 timed out during validation. Its stopped patch passed the phase-3 external grader afterward on a copy; the original score is unchanged.

Initial Astra native queue/planner v1 directories lacked the Codex companion host. Both were interrupted and excluded; recorded spend is at least $5.476761 and $0.1309105. Full replacements use the complete pinned bundle after a resumed file-editing preflight.

Native planner v2 was affected by macOS suspension and one missing terminal usage record. Both candidates passed3/3, but the pair is excluded; recorded spend is at least $3.968255. Replacement v3 uses a temporary idle-sleep inhibitor and independent clock checks.
Four short preflights are retained privately and excluded from scored performance.
Responses Lite encodes native instructions/tools differently; zero ordinary instruction/tool byte counters are not evidence that native Codex has no instructions or tools.
Fresh client homes do not reset provider caches.

excluded_runs.reason: Agent stopped the scheduler to pin CLIs; exec process cleanup also terminated its active benchmark child during profile turn2. Infrastructure interruption, not a model failure. All original artifacts retained; complete pair rerun in v2.

Pinned Codex executable was copied without codex-code-mode-host; native tools failed closed. The agent stopped the invalid run during native turn 3. Entire comparison excluded, artifacts and recorded spend retained; full pair repetitions will rerun with the complete pinned bundle after a tool-using preflight.

The prior scheduler automatically advanced before the missing Codex companion was copied. Startup recorded code mode unavailable; agent stopped scheduler and child. Entire run excluded and retained; full replacement uses complete pinned bundle after preflight.

macOS suspended during Gremlord planner turn2, with multiple 9-17 minute timestamp gaps despite a 251s monotonic duration. kern.sleeptime/waketime confirm sleep. Both candidates passed3/3 but one Gremlord API stream lacks terminal usage; timing/cost cannot support a clean paired comparison. Entire pair retained and excluded; rerun under task-scoped caffeinate -i.
